archetypes.name: hook-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The change crosses a Claude child-process boundary and a fail-open PreToolUse hook, so review should focus on env leakage and preserved guard behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the exemption can leak into the prompt-side orchestrator or other unintended sessions. Check that normal immediate-background polling remains denied without the exact child env var. Verify tests cover both the collateral-denial fix and the preserved guard purpose. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
